'''Diryk''' was the second-eldest son of [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu]] and Prince [[Brys Noramaga|Brys]] of [[Kandor]]. 

== Appearance ==
He was born in {{ne|971}} and died in {{ne|979}} at the age of eight. He was handsome with dark eyes.

== History ==
Somehow he survived a fifty foot fall without breaking a bone. Unfortunately this cast suspicion on whether he could channel or not. [[Merean Redhill]] threw him off a higher balcony thinking he may be the [[Dragon Reborn]]. He did not survive the fall this time.

It is explained as he was a victim of the male channeler pogrom, and his father died trying to protect him. Merean was an Aes Sedai of the Black Ajah. 

He had a tutor, called Mistress [[Tuval]]. {{ref|{{twotc}}, Diryk}}
